thread:
ana: quick gut-check on the billing/usage layout update. current dense legend + chips are crowding the sparkline and make quick comparisons hard.

kevin: noticed that too. when org and project rows have different chip counts the line height collapses oddly. feels jittery when toggling scope. :slightly_frowning_face:

zhou: proposal: introduce a two-line legend for compact mode so we don't shrink the chart area. first line = category labels, second line = 24h/7d totals. keeps width stable.

maya: accessibility concern: the tiny numeric badges are non-focusable and have poor contrast on hover. WCAG AA requires 3:1 for non-text UI; some badges hit 2.2:1. We should bump color or add a subtle stroke.

tonY-design: updated mock (mobile+desktop): https://redwood.internal/proto/billing-compact-2line-legend. I also experimented with an inline download action near the header: small icon + "Invoice" dropdown.

ana: inline invoice sounds useful but worried about discoverability on long pages. users often scroll past the top charts.

kevin: could add a sticky mini-toolbar that appears when you start scrolling; contains scope selector + invoice dropdown + quick date presets. show/hide with intersection observer to avoid extra DOM until needed.

zhou: implementation note: lazy-init the dropdown and use aria-controls to wire the trigger. pseudocode: `onFirstOpen(() => import('./InvoiceDropdown'))`. Also ensure keyboard open with Enter/Space and focus trap inside the dropdown.

maya: +1 on focus trap. Also request descriptive labels for screen readers: e.g., aria-label="Download invoice for current scope and range" rather than just "download".

tonY-design: copy question: should we label scope as "Organization" or "Account"? finance prefers "Account" but product team uses "Organization" in other places.

finance-bot: automated: finance glossary recommends "Billing Account" for invoices and "Organization" for user-facing team structures. If both must appear, recommend mapping "Billing Account" -> invoices and keep "Organization" for workspace context.

ana: ok let's avoid confusing users by using "Scope" as the visible label and show secondary text: "Billing account / Project" in smaller font. keeps the UI neutral.

kevin: chart labels: change small legend text from 'tokens' to 'Token units' to reduce ambiguity with billing vs usage. also increase tooltip pause to 200ms to help keyboard users.

zhou: color ordering: keep the same palette order across account vs project view. stable ordering reduces cognitive load when switching scope. add an explicit aria-describedby linking legend and chart for clarity.

maya: final a11y checklist for eng: focus styles for all interactive chips, keyboard access to download dropdown, contrast >=3:1 for badges, aria-labels for scope and invoices, screen-reader text for sparklines.

tonY-design: I'll produce a small spec doc with pixel sizes for compact mode (legend row heights, badge min-width 36px) and responsive rules.

ana: timeline: spike for sticky toolbar + a11y by Friday, design handoff Monday, dev sprint in next cycle. tagging: @kevin to own spike, @maya for a11y review, @tony-design to finalize mocks.

kevin: noted. I'll prototype the intersection observer pattern and measure initial DOM costs.

maya: thanks everyone. leaving a note: prefer 'Invoice' dropdown to include 'Export CSV' and 'Download PDF' options, and make file naming consistent: `redwood-invoice-<account>-<YYYY-MM>.pdf`.

tonY-design: added that to the spec. :thumbsup:

(archival: thread covers compact-mode legend, scope labeling, invoice CTA placement, and accessibility acceptance criteria for billing/usage dashboard iteration)
